source_definition._why_gate_a: Gate A natural paid-build evidence: an ordinary meadow-grass stop beside the open spine between the village and the pond route, far enough off the dirt to reward a short gathering detour without obstructing the critical trail. Together with the later pond-approach stop, this closes the fresh-session fiber shortfall without changing yields, costs, vendors, or global vegetation. Position is ground-probed and TUNABLE.
source_definition.label: Strip meadow grass

source_definition._comment_ow5d: OW5D, docs/specs/MEADOWS_MACRO_LAYOUT.md section 10.2: all five rootstone deposits below move by the same uniform (+377,+1642) offset as the quarry itself (old anchor (23,158) -> new (400,1800), see old_quarry.json), preserving their relative layout on the quarry floor exactly.
source_definition._comment_sd16: SD16, spec §3 Band 2 and §10: the Rootstone deposits on the Old Quarry's floor, reachable only past the South Bridge. Pickaxe-gated the same way stone is -- `gathered_with` on the ITEM (data/items/items.json), never on the node, so the rule lives in one place and a bare-handed player is told what they need rather than silently refused (OF20). Five deposits at 2 each: enough that a first visit is worth the walk, few enough that the quarry is a place you go back to rather than a vending machine. Amounts and positions TUNABLE; every one of them stands on the quarry pad (terrain_playground.json `flats`, centre [23,158] r8) and is clear of both foundations, the prop cluster and the conduit head by at least 4m so no two interact prompts contest.
source_definition.label: Prise out rootstone

source_definition._comment_ow5d: OW5D, docs/specs/MEADOWS_MACRO_LAYOUT.md section 10.2: all five ironwood nodes below move by the same uniform (-490,+2610) offset as the Burrow Warrens' `site.at` (70,-140) -> (-420,2470), preserving their relative layout around the mouth exactly. BAND2-63-WARRENS then moved the cave again, (-420,2470) -> (-357,2610), because the OW5D site could not be walked through (burrow_warrens.json's `_comment_resiting`); these five moved with it by that same (+63,+140) -- and then were RE-ARRANGED, because the blind visual pass found what a uniform translation had done: one ironwood stood inside the knoll, and three more stood in the doorway corridor, the nearest 8.5m dead in front of the mouth. The frame the critic saw was a full-canopy red tree filling the cave entrance. They are now a stand ringing the site at 34-46m, 26m or more off the doorway axis and outside the authored clearing, so the player walks past ironwood on the way in instead of through it.
source_definition.label: Fell an ironwood
